name: subha
text: one of the best makeup i have ever got for my occasions

name: Meera Krishnan
text: Flawless and lightweight! The makeup felt like second skin with no heavy cakey feeling, and it stayed fresh through the humid ceremony and stage flash photography.

name: Kavya Subramanian
text: Exact shade match for my dusky skin tone! She gave me an ethereal natural glow with subtle winged liner. Every single guest complimented how radiant I looked.

name: Nithya K.
text: My skin looked radiant, glassy and completely natural. The eye makeup was so detailed and elegant. Felt like an absolute queen on my special day!

name: Priyanka R.
text: The pre-pleating saved us so much time on my wedding morning! Within 8 minutes my heavy Kanchipuram silk was draped with razor-sharp box pleats that didn't budge through the entire muhurtham.

name: Deepika N.
text: Delivered neatly in a zipper bag with clear fold lines and strong pins. Sitting, walking and stage rituals were completely hassle-free. Best decision for my silk saree!

name: Shalini V.
text: Both my heavy pattu sarees were pre-pleated with exquisite precision. The pleats fell so symmetrically in all our wedding photographs!

name: Keerthana Rajesh
text: My bridal braid with fresh jasmine veni and temple jada was an absolute masterpiece! It felt completely weightless and held intact till the evening ceremony.

name: Swetha Murali
text: I wanted soft romantic curls with a delicate crystal accessory, and Zaisa recreated the exact Pinterest vision I had! The curls stayed bouncy all night without frizz.

name: Ananya S.
text: The jasmine poola jada was arranged with unbelievable perfection. Not a single petal dropped throughout the 5-hour ceremony!
